title: What is Arduino & How Does It Work?
summary: Discover the brain of your robot! Learn what microcontrollers do, explore the pins, and understand how power flows.

steps.title: Meet the Monster Brain
steps.markdownContent: Welcome to Monster Lab! Inside your kit is an **Arduino Uno**—a tiny computer designed to control sensors, lights, and motors in the real world.

steps.title: Inputs vs Outputs
steps.markdownContent: A microcontroller reads **Inputs** (eyes and ears like distance and sound sensors) and commands **Outputs** (hands and voice like motors and buzzers).

steps.title: Pin Tour: Power and Ground
steps.markdownContent: Locate the `5V` (Power) and `GND` (Ground) pins on your board. Electricity flows from 5V through your circuit and returns to GND!

steps.title: Knowledge Check
steps.markdownContent: What role does Ground (GND) play in an electrical circuit?

interactiveConfig.question: What is Ground (GND)?
options: A battery that provides unlimited power
The return path for electric current to complete the circuit
A sensor that measures dirt depth
